Metadata.title: Тоқ бар ма? — planned power outages in Almaty
Metadata.description: An unofficial map of planned power outages in Almaty, based on the schedules published by Alatau Zharyk Company (AZhK).
Metadata.keywords: Almaty, power outage, electricity, AZhK, outage schedule
Metadata.ogFeatures: Street search · AZhK schedule · unofficial service

Common.addressesInRussian: Addresses are shown in Russian, exactly as AZhK publishes them.

Header.disclaimer: Unofficial service: the data is parsed automatically from Alatau Zharyk Company's schedules and may contain parsing errors. Always check the <link>schedule on the AZhK website</link>.

Footer.updatedAt: Data updated: <time>{date}</time>. Names of private individuals from the schedules are never stored or shown.

Search.label: Street or microdistrict
Search.hint: Addresses are in Russian, as in the AZhK schedule, but you can search in Latin script: aigerim 1, ratushnogo, Abay Ave.

ResFilter.label: RES
ResFilter.hint: AZhK's district power network (РЭС). Don't know yours? Just search by street.
